name: Canterbury
note: Kit maker of the Ireland and Japan 2026/27 home shirts, listed as partner per the convention for kit suppliers. Owned by Pentland Brands, part of Pentland Group, per pentlandgroup.com/about-us; Pentland Group is owned by the Rubin family (Bailiwick Express, Feb 2023, reporting The Sunday Times). Japan national-team jerseys are designed and manufactured by Tokyo-listed Goldwin Inc.; the Japan design debuted in 2025. Main's unrated status is retained pending a maintainer's rating decision.
